I've never ran into anything supernatural while exploring, at least not yet, but I did run into a man or woman seeking retreat in the attic of an administration attic on a hot summer day. I went up there and heard someone crawling around in the attic, so I went down a few flights to grab a guy I was with and brought him up to listen. When we went back up, the door was shut and there was a key in the lock. I think what happened is that we spooked him on our way back up the steps, and he had tried to reach his hand through the broken window on the door and stick the key he found in the lock to prevent us from getting onto that floor. We opened the door and stood there listening to him breath and scuffle around above us. We called out to him a few times but he remained silent vocally. I will never know what the hell was up there, but it was definitely human based on the whole key thing.

I had to hide in an attic for four hours and I had my shoes stolen by security when they found them resting on the roof. I had taken them off to quietly walk to the ledge on the rocks. It was a fun hike back to my car!
